traits.name: Blend With Stone
traits.text:
The lythic has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth)
checks in rocky terrain, and can take the Hide action whenever it is within
10 feet of some sort of stone, and remains hidden unless it moves or
attacks.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text:
The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked
earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn’t disturb the material
it moves through.

traits.name: Fury of the Earth
traits.text:
Whenever the lythic starts its turn with half its hit
points or fewer, it flies into a berserker-like rage. On each of its turns while
berserk, the lythic deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage with its slam attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lythic makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
